reviews.title: Bait-and-switch — lifetime unlimited turned into 40-per-week limit
reviews.text:
I paid for Lifetime Pro Access with unlimited usage as a one-time purchase. The developer unilaterally changed the terms after purchase and capped me at 40 images per week — no notice, no consent, no explanation.

"Restore Purchase" confirms I am a Pro Member, but the weekly limit remains. They still sell "Unlimited Pro" to new customers at higher prices — so the feature exists, they just won’t honour it for lifetime buyers.

I’ve contacted support repeatedly over more than a week, sent a formal final notice — and they have not replied or resolved anything. If you’re considering a lifetime deal, be very careful — they appear to change the rules after you pay.

Reported to CMA and Trading Standards for deceptive practices.

reviews.title: STAY AWAY
reviews.text:
I very rarely write negative reviews, but this experience has left me with no choice.
I purchased the Lifetime Pro Membership, and according to Parrot AI’s own development team, this should give me access to create videos. Unfortunately, I still cannot create any videos because the platform keeps telling me that I have no credits.
I contacted customer support immediately. They asked me to provide all of my purchase details, receipts, and account information, which I sent without delay. After that… complete silence. No updates, no resolution, no explanation.
Paying for a lifetime subscription and then being unable to use one of its core features is frustrating enough, but being ignored by support after providing everything they requested is completely unacceptable.
I am not someone who normally writes reviews, but this level of customer service is simply appalling. I sincerely hope Parrot AI improves both its support and the way it handles paying customers.

reviews.title: Yet another con
reviews.text: Having foolishly signed up as a pro member to get ‘unlimited creating ability’ I started my first project only for it to be stopped at the generation phase by having to buy credits to continue. There really should be a way to stop companies promising you something like unlimited ability to create only to stop you at the first one and charge you £7 for SIX credits. Absolute con, wish I hadn’t bothered with it. Save you money don’t buy pro.
